description: YuE2 music generation model with symbolic ABC planning, semantic codec generation, NAR acoustic flow synthesis, and Oobleck VAE decode.

request.name: style
request.description: Song style/tags.

request.name: lyrics
request.description: Lyrics text. Leave empty for instrumental generation; if omitted, the CLI text input is used.

request.name: cot
request.description: Symbolic planning route. off skips ABC generation; melody/full generate or consume ABC before music tokens.

request.name: stop_after
request.description: Last stage to run. abc writes the generated score only; semantic also writes the semantic token export; audio renders the full song.

request.name: abc
request.description: External ABC score text for melody/full routes.

request.name: abc_file
request.description: Path to an external ABC score file for melody/full routes.

request.name: semantic_prefix
request.description: JSON array of semantic codec indices to force as the start of the music stream.

request.name: semantic_prefix_file
request.description: Path to a JSON array of semantic codec indices to force as the start of the music stream.

request.name: nar_noise_file
request.description: Path to a raw float32 noise file for NAR generation, shaped [frames,64].

request.name: export_semantic
request.description: Attach the semantic token stream as a semantic artifact (JSON array of codec indices); default false.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Semantic classifier-free guidance scale. Default follows the upstream route defaults. Omitted defaults to 1.01 with cot=off, otherwise 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed. Must be nonnegative and less than 2^63.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: NAR midpoint ODE steps.

request.name: abc_temperature
request.description: ABC planner sampling temperature.

request.name: abc_top_p
request.description: ABC planner nucleus sampling probability. Must be in (0, 1].

request.name: abc_top_k
request.description: ABC planner top-k sampling limit.

request.name: abc_repetition_penalty
request.description: ABC planner repetition penalty. Must be positive.

request.name: abc_penalty_window
request.description: ABC planner repetition penalty window.

request.name: abc_min_tokens
request.description: Minimum ABC planner tokens before EOS is accepted.

request.name: abc_max_tokens
request.description: Maximum ABC planner tokens. Zero is allowed when min_tokens is also zero.

request.name: semantic_temperature
request.description: Semantic codec sampling temperature.

request.name: semantic_top_p
request.description: Semantic codec nucleus sampling probability. Must be in (0, 1].

request.name: semantic_top_k
request.description: Semantic codec top-k sampling limit.

request.name: semantic_repetition_penalty
request.description: Semantic codec repetition penalty. Must be positive.

request.name: semantic_penalty_window
request.description: Semantic codec repetition penalty window.

request.name: semantic_min_tokens
request.description: Minimum semantic tokens before EOS is accepted.

request.name: semantic_max_tokens
request.description: Maximum semantic codec tokens. Zero is allowed when min_tokens is also zero.

session.name: ar_lora
session.description: AR adapter safetensors file; native, PEFT, and ComfyUI LoRA layouts. Absolute path or relative to the model root. Requires session reload.

session.name: ar_lora_scale
session.description: AR LoRA delta scale; zero disables the adapter. Requires session reload.

session.name: nar_lora
session.description: NAR adapter safetensors file. Absolute path or relative to the model root. Requires session reload.

session.name: nar_lora_scale
session.description: NAR LoRA delta scale; full vae2llm/llm2vae replacements are unscaled. Zero disables the entire adapter. Requires session reload.

session.name: model_weight_type
session.description: YuE2 MoT weight storage type. Omitted inherits weight_type.

session.name: model_gguf
session.description: Yue2 main AR/NAR component GGUF file relative to the model root.

session.name: vae_gguf
session.description: Yue2 VAE component GGUF file relative to the model root.

session.name: vae_weight_type
session.description: YuE2 VAE weight storage type. Omitted inherits weight_type.

session.name: model_weight_context_mb
session.description: YuE2 MoT weight context size in MiB.

session.name: vae_weight_context_mb
session.description: YuE2 VAE weight context size in MiB.

session.name: ar_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AR prefill graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: ar_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AR one-token decode graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: nar_graph_arena_mb
session.description: NAR acoustic flow graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: vae_graph_arena_mb
session.description: VAE decode graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: attention
session.description: NAR acoustic-flow attention lowering; auto selects the backend-appropriate implementation.

session.name: attention_tile_rows
session.description: Query rows per eager NAR attention tile; nonpositive values select automatic tiling to keep each score matrix below 3 GiB.
